newsitem.title: FRANCE: EuroCommissioner Silguy wants European referendums.
newsitem.headline: EuroCommissioner Silguy wants European referendums.

text.p: European Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy suggested on Friday that referendums be held in member states of the European Union to allow pressing major issues such as defence to become clearer to those affected by them.
"Europe must be made more transparent," de Silguy told radio France-Inter.
"Decision-taking must become clearer. That's why I think there should be European referendums where all citizens would be consulted," said de Silguy, commissioner for economic and financial affairs.

"Take the case of defence matters for example which affect all citizens. One day we will have to clarify the issue of European defence. It does not seem illogical to me that one day or another we should consult all the citizens of Europe about the type of defence which they want for Europe," he said.
